summary: Scheduled dashboard report strips tracehook links when panels use nested variables and sampling
description:
Issue summary:
Customer scheduled PDF/CSV reports generated from a dashboard are delivered without functional tracehook links when at least one panel uses nested/dashboard variables combined with query sampling. Links in the live dashboard UI are present and clickable, but the exported scheduled report contains either empty tracehook placeholders or truncated URLs.

Impact:
- VelaPay relies on scheduled reports for daily compliance sampling; missing tracehook links prevent analysts from jumping to traces for flagged anomalies.
- Affects scheduled exports across the org for dashboards that use nested variable resolution + sampling. Estimated ~12 scheduled jobs per day impacted for the customer.

Environment:
- Redwood Console (hosted), prod/us-east region, customer on Dedicated tier (VelaPay).
- Dashboards include panels with nested variables (org-level -> route regex -> tag). Query sampling at panel-level enabled (sample_rate ~0.1). Retention compacting enabled on org partition.

Steps to reproduce (customer-provided):
1) Create dashboard with two panels: A) raw events panel with nested variables in the WHERE clause; B) metric aggregation panel.
2) Enable panel-level query sampling on panel A (0.1).
3) Configure scheduled export (daily PDF and CSV) for dashboard with "attach tracehook" enabled.
4) Wait for scheduled job to run or trigger manual send.

Observed behavior:
- Scheduled PDF/CSV contains tracehook column values like "TRACEHOOK=;" or truncated urls missing runId and token.
- Live dashboard "Open trace" links on the same panels work and include full runId/token.

Expected behavior:
- Scheduled exports should preserve working tracehook links identical to the UI (or link back to the same runId/token namespace).

Temporary workaround:
- Customer disabled panel-level sampling and re-ran scheduled report; links returned. Not ideal due to cost/volume requirements.
comments: 2026-03-11 09:18 - Elena Park (Reporter): Customer submitted logs and reproducible dashboard JSON. Scheduling id: sched_ve_9045. Attached example CSV where tracehook column is empty.
2026-03-11 11:02 - Miguel Santos (Assignee): Acknowledged. Reproducing in staging using provided dashboard JSON and sampling config. Will capture scheduler/run logs and tracehook generation path.

2026-03-12 15:27 - SRE Team (channel #support): Observed that scheduled-run pipeline uses compacted rollup storage path for sampled queries which strips tracehook metadata during export join. Raising as suspected cause.

2026-03-12 17:40 - Miguel Santos: Collected exporter logs (exporter:sched-job-902999) and query planner traces. Found that export task fetches pre-aggregated rows from rollup store; tracehook tokens are stored only in raw-event shards. When sampling is applied, planner chooses rollup path and then attempts to synthesize tracehook values but the synth step relies on a full event runId map which is pruned during retention compact.
investigation_notes: Logs: exporter logs show "tracehook_lookup_missing" entries correlated to scheduled runs that hit rollup store. Query planner uses plan hash H=0x7f4a when sampling_enabled=true and nested_vars_present=true; plan chooses 'rollup-scan' instead of 'raw-scan' to satisfy latency SLO for scheduled jobs. Retention compact deletes per-event runId mapping from older partitions; tracehook synthesis falls back to empty token. Hypothesis: planner changes plan under sampling+nested-vars and exporter doesn't rehydrate tokens from raw shards. Repro steps in staging confirmed: disabling sampling forces 'raw-scan' and tracehooks appear. Related to commit https://github.com/redwood-inference/ingest/commit/aa12b3 from retention compact reorder (recent).
resolution: Workaround provided to customer: disable panel-level sampling for affected dashboards or change scheduled export to run with parameter 'force_raw_scan=true' (internal flag) until fix deployed. Engineering action: patch query planner to prefer raw-scan for scheduled exports when tracehook export flag is set OR ensure exporter can rehydrate tracehook tokens from raw shards even when plan used rollup results. Patch PR opened and targeted for next canary: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4913. Planned rollout: canary -> us-east -> global over 72 hours. Post-deploy validation: run 5 scheduled exports across 3 dashboards with nested-vars + sampling and verify tracehook links. Follow-up: add unit test for scheduled-export tracehook preservation and add dashboard-level lint to warn when sampling will drop tracehooks.
